name: tool-bench
title: Tool Bench
purpose: Single-file host for small HTML tools that front CA_V3 flows: shared config injection, sandboxed runs, tool contracts naming the CA_V3 objects each tool depends on.

protocols.name: tool_config_injection
protocols.detail: window.TOOL_CONFIG and window.TOOL_META injected into inline tools before their own scripts

protocols.name: toolbench_config_message
protocols.detail: postMessage {type: toolbench:config, config, meta} to linked tools, targeted at the link's origin

ca.kinds_note: snapshot of the declared kind prefixes (std kind via std change_broker kinds_known v9, 2026-10-23); used by the bench to flag kind_undeclared keys in tool contracts

governance.gate: merge to main only after the change's deploy card lands

releases.note: repo build, manifest, schema-2 storage with v1 migration, tool contracts, per-tool history, hardening
